os2warp.name: OS/2 Warp
os2warp.description: The WarpCenter along the top and a window with its title in the middle around each scene: the Desktop menu opens a scene, the Window List the windows, and the clock the frame's System Setup. On a Pi or an ESP32 every scene opens in a window of its own, with the LaunchPad and its drawer on the desktop, a system menu on every window and OS/2's keys.
